units.source_text: 太吉郎又说：“如果屋主想到今年胡枝子会开得更美丽，他大概也不舍得卖掉这所房子吧。

en.t: Taikichiro added, "If the owner thought the bush clover would bloom even more beautifully this year, he probably would not have had the heart to sell this house.

units.source_text: 可是到了非卖不可的时候，恐怕也就顾不上胡枝子花是凋谢还是纷乱了。”

en.t: But when the time comes that he has no choice but to sell it, I suppose he can no longer worry about whether the bush clover flowers are fading or growing wild."
